job: Show the detail of something picked from a list without losing the list.
purpose: A native dialog that slides in from the right at 420px (560px for wide content), from the left for navigation and filters, and from the bottom on phones. Modal by default: Escape, a close button and a backdrop click close it. data-modeless leaves the page in use: no scrim or trap, it swaps content when opened from another row, and is a half-height bottom sheet on phones. Fires fd:open, fd:close and fd:change.
useWhen: A row in a table or a log opens its full detail beside the list.
A detail panel beside something the person keeps working with, such as a map, a canvas or a live list (data-modeless).
A filter or navigation panel slides in from the left on a small screen.
A multi-step flow needs more room than a dialog.

avoidWhen.when: A short question that needs a yes or no.
A panel anchored to a button.
A permanent column beside the page, never dismissed.
A task the person must finish or cancel, shown in a modeless sheet.
avoidWhen.instead: The modal sheet (leave out data-modeless), or a dialog

aka: panel that keeps the page usable

states.name: dragging

states.how: data-step on a section; [data-fd-dialog-step] buttons move between steps

variants.useWhen: Detail of a row; the default.
The page behind stays in use: no scrim, lock or trap, and opening it from another row swaps its content.
Wide content such as a response body, 560px.
A full record, a decision or a comparison that needs room: half the window, and never narrower than lg. On a phone it is the bottom sheet like every size.
On a footer child: pushes it to the start edge, as a secondary action.

parts.role: A compact title row with the title and controls, used in place of the head.
A muted line under the title.
A titled group inside the body.

keyboard.does: Closes the sheet and returns focus to the trigger; a modeless sheet only while focus is inside it.
Stays inside a modal sheet. A modeless sheet follows its trigger: Tab on it goes in, Tab past the end goes on.
From the start of a modeless sheet, back to its trigger.
